title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day leak racks up millions of views
summary: Endgame went on to set staggering records for opening weekend, grossing over $1.2 billion worldwide and over $350 million in the US. Between previews and opening day, it’s already grossed $168 million , which puts it ahead of Endgame’s $157.4 million.
